33100.commentary: (MNa) kāyaduṭṭhullan'ti kāy'ālasiyabhāvo. (MNa) duṭṭhullan'ti mayā vīriyaṃ gāḷhaṃ paggahitaṃ, tena me uppilaṃ uppannan'ti vīriyaṃ sithilam'akāsi, tato kāyadaratho kāyaduṭṭhullaṃ kāy'ālasiyaṃ udapādi.

examples.text: idh'ānanda bhikkhu upadhivivekā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā sabbaso kāyaduṭṭhullānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati

samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ. so'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati, na amanasikāro, na thinamiddhaṃ, na chambhitattaṃ, na uppilaṃ, na duṭṭhullan'ti.

33101.commentary: (VIN 1.2.3) duṭṭhullā nāma vācā vaccamagga-passāvamagga-methunadhamma-ppaṭisaṃyuttā vācā. (VINa) duṭṭhullan'ti duṭṭhuñ'ca kilesehi duṭṭhattā, thūlañ'ca anipuṇabhāvato'ti duṭṭhullaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methun'upasaṃhitāhi, saṅgh'ādiseso.
methunadhammo nāma yo so asaddhammo gāmadhammo vasaladhammo duṭṭhullaṃ odak'antikaṃ rahassaṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpatti, eso methunadhammo nāma.

33102.meaning1: (of an offence) serious; heavy; bad; corrupt
33102.commentary: (VIN 2.5.1.9) duṭṭhullā nāma āpatti, cattāri ca pārājikāni, terasa ca saṅgh'ādisesā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ anupasampannassa āroceyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

33103.meaning1: rude words; obscene speech; vulgar language; lewd talk

examples.text: atha saṭṭhinissitā savitakkā, puthū janatāya adhammā niviṭṭhā, na ca vaggagatassa kuhiñci, no pana duṭṭhullabhāṇī sa bhikkhu.

33105.meaning1: speaking coarsely; talking crudely; uttering lewd speech

examples.text: atha saṭṭhinissitā savitakkā, puthū janatāya adhammā niviṭṭhā, na ca vaggagatassa kuhiñci, no pana duṭṭhullabhāṇī sa bhikkhu.

33108.meaning1: rude and polite speech; coarse and refined words; lewd and not lewd speech
33108.commentary: (VINa) viññū paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhull'āduṭṭhullaṃ ājānitun'ti yā paṇḍitā sātthakaniratthakakathaṃ asaddhamma-saddhamma-paṭisaṃyutta-kathañ'ca jānituṃ paṭibalā, ayaṃ idha adhippetā. yā pana mahallikāpi bālā elamūgā ayaṃ idha anadhippetāti dasseti.

examples.text: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī, na petī, na tiracchānagatā. viññū paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhull'āduṭṭhullaṃ ājānituṃ.
aññatra viññunā purisaviggahenā'ti ṭhapetvā viññuṃ purisaviggahaṃ. viññū nāma purisaviggaho, paṭibalo hoti subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhull'āduṭṭhullaṃ ājānituṃ.

33109.meaning1: due to heaviness; because of discomfort

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, anuruddhā, etadahosi, duṭṭhullaṃ kho me udapādi, duṭṭhull'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.
duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā duṭṭhull'āpattisaññī anupasampannassa āroceti, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

idh'upāli, bhikkhū anāpattiṃ āpattī'ti dīpenti, āpattiṃ anāpattī'ti dīpenti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ garuk'āpattī'ti dīpenti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ lahuk'āpattī'ti dīpenti, duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ aduṭṭhullāpattī'ti dīpenti, aduṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ duṭṭhullāpattī'ti dīpenti, sāvasesaṃ āpattiṃ anavases'āpattī'ti dīpenti, anavasesaṃ āpattiṃ sāvases'āpattī'ti dīpenti, sappaṭikammaṃ āpattiṃ appaṭikamm'āpattī'ti dīpenti, appaṭikammaṃ āpattiṃ sappaṭikamm'āpattī'ti dīpenti. imāni kho, upāli, dasa vivādamūlānī'ti.
duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā duṭṭhull'āpattisaññī anupasampannassa āroceti, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

33112.meaning1: rule about informing (about another monk's) serious (offence); Pācittiya 9

examples.text: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.

33115.meaning1: as a companion; as a partner
33115.commentary: (SNa) saddhā dutiyā purisassa hotī'ti purisassa devaloke manussaloke c'eva nibbānañ'ca gacchantassa saddhā dutiyā hoti, sahāyakiccaṃ sādheti.

examples.text: taṇhādutiyo puriso, dīgham'addhāna saṃsaraṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.
saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, no ce assaddhiyaṃ avatiṭṭhati, yaso ca kittī ca tatv'assa hoti, saggañ'ca so gacchati sarīraṃ vihāyā'ti.

33116.meaning1: (gram) second consonant of each vagga; kh, ch, ṭh, th, ph

examples.text: abbhāsagatānaṃ dutiyacatutthānaṃ paṭhamatatiyā honti. ciccheda, bubhukkhati, babhūva, dadhāti.
